title: Regeneration of Intrabony Defects Using a Novel Magnesium
authors: Membrane Hangyasi, David Botond, Győző Körtvélyessy, Marko Blašković, Patrick Rider, Svenja Rogge, Stjepan Siber, Željka Perić Kačarević, and Marija Čandrlić. 2023. Medicina 59, no. 11: 2018.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss NOVAMag (magnesium membrane, screw, SHIELD) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Overall, the use of the different shapes of the magnesium membrane in the treatment of IBD resulted in a satisfactory functional and esthetic outcome” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
